notes.title: Update V0.3.35
notes.notes:
Today we are announcing that we’ll stop the development of LuckCatchers in a few months. We’ll be waiting for you in LuckCatchers 2. 
To make this transition easy for you, we took the following steps:

The checkbook and possibility of buying gold louis d’ors for real money are disabled from this moment.
During a certain period of time, we will buy K-series ships and yachts from you for golden louis d’or in the capitals of the world. If you create the lot for sale, we’ll buy it from you. The maximum price for a K-series ship is 25.000 gold louis d’ors, for a yacht is 300.000 gold louis d’ors.
For dismantling of your own settlement, built from a license, you will automatically receive 100% compensation in gold louis d’ors.
All your LuckCatchers accounts and gold louis d’ors will be moved to LuckCatchers 2.
In LuckCatchers 2, your gold louis d’ors from LuckCatchers will be converted to Relic Gold at a 1:1 ratio.
Gold louis d’ors, spent on the character slots and portraits, will be returned to your account at the time of the launch of LuckCatchers 2 in Relic Gold.

Relic Gold
Relic Gold is a special type of currency in LuckCatchers 2
Ways to acquire it:

Automatic conversion of gold louis d’ors from LuckCatchers to LuckCatchers 2 at a 1:1 ratio.
Automatic conversion of the cost of portraits and characters at a 1:1 ratio.

Where to spend it:

Purchase special offer items.
Buying/selling Relic Gold with gold louis d’ors in LuckCatchers 2.

Do you still have questions? Ask in the comments!

notes.title: Update V0.3.34
notes.notes: Technical update. Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Update V0.3.33
notes.notes: Reduced the number of digits in numbers indicating the durability of buildings, ships and strekolets, and the amount of damage done and received.

notes.title: Update V0.3.32
notes.notes:
Interface

The descriptions of the upper interface bar now are located under the cursor.

Enhancers

The functionality of installing enhancers into empty slots of buildings and ships has been expanded. Simply left-click on an empty enhancer slot, and a list with available enhancers will appear. In this list, select the enhancer you want to install and click on it with the left mouse button.

notes.title: Update V0.3.31
notes.notes:
Bug fixes

Corrected an issue that prevented sending chat messages using the Enter key.
Fixed a bug with naming Markers.
Resolved an issue with inability to open conversations containing lots of telegrams.

notes.title: Update V0.3.30
notes.notes:
The New Year event has ended. All snowflakes and snowmen have melted.
Increased size of the Navigation system window.

notes.title: Update V0.3.29
notes.notes:
New Year Event

The New Year event has ended.
You can exchange the remaining Snowflakes and Snowmen for livres in any city in the world until January 27, 2021.
On January 27, 2021, all the remaining Snowflakes and Snowmen will melt.
Bug fixes

Fixed an error that prevented the learning of a skill even if you read a book.

Strekolets

Increased the speed of strekolets under the Glide mode.

notes.title: Technical update V0.3.28
notes.notes:
Fixed a game crash after entering with a new character.
Fixed the dragon wings confirmation window.

notes.title: Update V0.3.27
notes.notes:
Collect Snowmen and Snowflakes!

You can get Snowmen and Snowflakes as a reward for completing daily and weekly tasks. 
You can find Snowmen and Snowflakes in trophies on the wreckage of a ship. 
You can exchange Snowmen and Snowflakes for valuable rewards in the capitals. 
The event will last till January 20, 2021. 
In the capitals of the factions, Christmas trees were installed.

notes.title: Update V0.3.25
notes.notes:
Spread of the Outcasts

The Outcasts decided to spread pirate influence and seize territories of the Empire and the Union.
Most settlements of the outcasts are shown on the mini-map and in the Navigation system.
Some settlements can be destroyed by the Mk2 ships, while others require you to have several ships of the 200 series.

notes.title: Update V 0.3.24
notes.notes:
New functions of navigation systems
We have added new markers to make your life easier.

A green round marker shows the location of your character.
Yellow round markers indicate the cities/settlements from which you need to pick up the cargo under the taken contract.
Orange round markers indicate the cities/settlements to which you need to deliver the cargo under the taken contract.
Hovering the cursor over a city/town/ship will show routes from the location to the final destinations.

notes.title: Update V0.3.23
notes.notes:
Navigation system
Captains! We are glad to present you a new feature - Navigation system. It replaced the old World Map but retained its basic functions.
This system will show your ships, airships and strekolets in flight, regardless of their location.
Other characters' aircraft are shown within a 30-mile radius of your location.
The functionality of the system will be expanded later.

Skills
Now when you cancel the learning of a skill, money spent on learning are refunded in proportion to the remaining time. The less time is left, the less money will be returned to the character's account.

notes.title: Update V0.3.19
notes.notes:
Interface
We've improved the item placement algorithm!

Added the "Ship layout" or "Anti-aircraft platform layout" windows. To place items in these windows, open one of them and left-click on any of the slots there. In the list of available items that appears, select the one that you want to install.
Installation and replacement are available for any slot on the layout.
Please note that only items in warehouses of a city or settlement will be available to you. Items in holds of ships or strekolets are not displayed in the list.
Be careful! In case of replacement of the installed item, there must be free space in the hold of the ship or the warehouse of the anti-aircraft platform.

notes.title: Update V0.3.17
notes.notes:
Starter ships
The loss of ships can upset you. Especially well-stocked ships if you are a new player.

 Now all the ships of new captains are protected for the duration of the Beginner protection.
 If a ship is destroyed, it will be moved to the docking port in the capital of your faction with 1 strength point remaining.
 All installed weapons, enhancers, ammunition, demon, engine, and even fuel in the tank - everything will remain in place.

The contents of the ship's hold will be in the crash site.


Contracts

 Captains who have taken shipping contracts can land to pick up cargo regardless of the settlements permissions setting.
 To deliver the cargo, it is enough to drop it over the consignee flight centre.


Bug fixes

 Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when switching between characters.
 Fixed a bug due to which the game crashed when moving property from the warehouse to the hold, from the hold to the weapon slots, ammunition, fuel tank.

notes.title: Update V0.3.14
Update V0.3.13
notes.notes:
Contracts

Cargo delivery is one of the main ways that enables you not only to make money but also transport large amounts of property in one container. The Insurance deposit guarantees the safety of the cargo. However, some captains flout the insurance deposits and keep cargo for themselves.

From that day, the transported cargo, in case of expiration of the delivery time or attempt to open it, regardless of its location, will be returned to the warehouse of the sender's Flight Centre.

notes.title: Update V0.3.12
notes.notes:
Search

In the Market and Property windows, the possibility of searching for resources and materials is added. To search an item, enter any letters contained in its name.

Markers of the buildings

Buildings in cities and towns now have additional markers.
Green marker means there is a room for movable property in the warehouse.
Red marker means that the warehouse is not available or there is no space for the movable property.
These markers are displayed when moving the property with the mouse.

Moving property between warehouses

We have simplified the process of moving property between warehouses. You know that by clicking LMB, you can select the property in one or several cells of the warehouse. Previously, to move the selected item, it was required to hold LMB and move the cursor to another open warehouse window. Now, to move items in the selected cells, just click on the move button.

notes.title: Update V0.3.09
notes.notes:
Portraits

Added 2 unique portraits.

Interface

Improved display of fonts.

notes.title: Update V0.3.07
notes.notes:
Dragons

Increased the aggressiveness of dragon packs and individual dragons.

Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Update V 0.3.06
notes.notes:
Bug fixes

Fixed a bug due to which the duration of the Magic Anchor was displayed incorrectly.
Fixed a bug where custom settings were reset to default values.
Fixed a bug that led to incorrect display of the Beginner protection timer.
Fixed a bug that affected the counting of days in the Login Rewards system.

Players who were the first to discover these bugs have received rewards.

notes.title: Update V0.3.05
notes.notes:
Rating leaders

Now being the leader of the Rating is not only honorable but also profitable.
Characters that make it to the Top 10 in each Rating category by the end of a game year will receive rewards.
Rewards will be credited automatically at the end of the game year. They can be found in the capital.

Rewards will be credited automatically at the end of the game year. They can be found in the capital.

notes.notes:
Cargo ownership

Purchased or rewarded cargoes have no owner. Any character can open it.

Bug fixes

Fixed crash of the game client when opening a cargo by characters with access to the settlement.
Fixed a bug that led to incorrect display of flight altitude in the Altimeter when the altitude module is installed.

notes.title: Update V0.3.04
notes.notes:
Login Rewards

Receive rewards for logging in to the game every day!
The reward counter resets on the 1st day of every month.
Enter the game 28 times a month to collect all rewards.

Chest with equipment

Now it is possible to receive any of SM series engines.

Chest with equipment

All types of missiles and torpedoes, ground-based missile launchers and torpedo racks have been added.

Bug fixes

Fixed a bug in the operation of ship modules.
Fixed a bug that led to incorrect weight calculation of extracted resources.

notes.title: Update V0.3.02
notes.notes:
Consumer goods system
We introduce you a new system of consumer goods.
A total of 16 new consumer goods production chains have been added.
Each chain consist of the following stages:[olist]
Collect resource
Pack it into a crate
Transport crate to the city, which processes this resource into new materials
Produce material using this crate
Transport material to the place of production of the final product
Produce the final product from this material
Deliver the final product to any city for sale[/olist]
It is also possible to sell resources, resource crates and materials to a city. In return, the city will put up the next item in the production chain for sale.
You can find all production chains by reading the descriptions of the products.

All old consumer goods, such as crates with corn, containers with corn, and others have been removed from the game and from all storages and warehouses.
Also we removed the "Tobacco" item. Instead of it, now it is possible to mine "Amber".

Dragons
Flocks of dragons have been added.

Bug fixes
Fixed some minor issues.

notes.title: Update V0.3.00
notes.notes:
Black market
The "Black market" section has appeared on the market. Here you can buy special cargoes for louis d'or. These cargoes contain various in-game items.

Carriers
Small damaged ships can be found around the world. Hurry up to collect the remains of the dying ships before they disappear, or someone hasn't collected them before you. The difficult part is that they are not visible on the world map.

Bug fixes
Fixed some bugs and improved client stability.

notes.title: Technical update V0.2.99
notes.notes:
Ship groups

Now, ships, controlled by the navigation system, can be selected into a group using the SHIFT key. Also, it is possible to assign a group number for ships. To do so hold the SHIFT key and click on a ship icon several times until you get the desired group number.

Bug fixes

Fixed a bug with the "dead zone" in the upper left corner, in which it was difficult to drag/select items.
The "Landing" permission was removed in all buildings, except for runways and docking ports. Fixed bug with automatic unchecking of this field.
Fixed bug where when closing the "Skill tree" the buttons on the panel became inactive.

notes.title: Update V0.2.98
notes.notes:
Missiles and missile launchers

The flight range of R-1, RSN-1, R-1I, RSN-1I missiles was reduced by 2 times.
Ground-based missile launchers have been added for installation on ground-based anti-aircraft platforms.
Ground-based missile launchers use R-1G and RSN-1G missiles.
The production of ground-based missile launchers and missiles to them has been added to the game.

Other

The landing cooldown after take-off has been reduced to 60 seconds.

Attention!
In one of the next updates, we plan to change the system of consumer goods. Please minimize the amount of goods in your warehouses to avoid possible losses in the form of game currency.

notes.title: Technical update V0.2.97
notes.notes:
Technical update V0.2.97

Fixed a bug that caused the game client to crash when a player selected a ship in a Docking port.
Fixed a bug that led to the display of misleading data when a player used ship modules.

notes.title: Update V0.2.96
notes.notes:
Market
Trading without restrictions!From this day, we remove the range limits for the stores of settlements.

Information about any trading lots created by you in your settlement will be available to everyone, anywhere in the world.
You can right-click on a trading lot to show the direction to the settlement in which it was created. The direction will be shown on the minimap.
The radius of the radio communications of the stores in cities remains the same - 30 miles.

Dragon migration
Brave dragon hunters! This information is for you. Now, the dragon migration will take place not once, but four times during one game year:

From 81 to 92 days;
From 171 to 182 days;
From 261 to 272 days;
From 351 to 362 days.

Stock up on ammunition!

Ship parts

The way of airships and ships construction has been changed. Now, they are build of parts that can be produced in forge shops, wood shops and farms.
Ship repairs are carried out using repair kits. Repair kits consist of various ship parts.
A corresponding tab has been added to the Market.

Beginner skills
We have expanded the list of skills available for learning during the period of Beginner protection:

A level 2 Pilotage skill enables you to control up to six ships at a time.
A level 2 Piloting human cargo ships skill provides access to piloting airships and ships Dodger, Wolf 150 and Negotiator.
A level 2 Piloting orc cargo ships skill opens access to piloting airships and ships Tractor, Boar 150 and Merchant.
A level 2 Piloting human warships skill enables you to pilot Blade 100 ships.
A level 2 Piloting orc warships skill enables you to pilot Toad 100 ships.

notes.title: Update V0.2.95
Update V0.2.94
notes.notes:
Demons' Henchmen

Demons' Henchmen arrived into the world to prey on Pieces of the Inside Out.

It's your choice

Every nomad in Sorharon carries a Piece of the Inside Out. You can help nomads get to the capital by destroying search squads of henchmen.

Silver Rewards

Captains receive silver livres for damaging the ships of the Henchmen and the Outcasts (except for the War event).
The holds of the henchmen's ships are full of rare books, magic, potions, materials, and much more.

notes.title: Update V0.2.93
notes.notes:
Industrial extraction of resources

The list of resources extracted by the special ship "Prospector" has been expanded. Now "Prospector" can extract granite, pumice, quartz, volcanic silt and tuff.

Steam amplifier

Steam amplifier enables the industrial extraction of minerals. It is sold in the Gnome Shop.

Free settlement to each new player!

Each new player can establish a settlement for free.

Friends Reunion

The event "Friends Reunion" is active again! Captains, who reenter the world on the Edge of the Inside Out after a long break, will receive 9 unique medallions.

notes.title: Update V0.2.92
notes.notes:
Wisdom Potions

Wisdom Potions appeared in the World on the Edge of the Inside Out. These potions enable players to learn skills faster.
You can receive Wisdom Potions for completing Tasks or for participating in Events.

notes.title: Update V0.2.91
notes.notes:
Engineering bureau

An Engineering bureau building has been added to Castles, enabling the production of improved engines and cannons.

Tools and Alchemy

The Gnome Shop’s market now sells Huge turbines and Durable drills. Huge turbines are required to produce improved engines, and Durable drills are needed to produce improved cannons.

Special skill levels

Special levels have been added to the “Heavy Weapons” skill. The book “Fire Star” opens access to learning special levels of this skill.

Concentrates

Concentrates are required to produce engines and cannons. Concentrates can be made in alchemic shops of Сastles and Drilling platforms.

Market

Now it is possible to create trading lots to buy/sell all types of engines and cannons.

Free settlement to each new player!

One of the characters of a new account, during the period of the "Beginner protection", can establish one settlement for free.
The “Establish a settlement” button is available to a character in any ship that this character controls manually.
A settlement can be established in any available location that is indicated by a grey square on the minimap.
During the "Beginner protection", only the owner of the settlement can land in it.
With the expiration of the “Beginner protection”, the opportunity to establish a free settlement ends too.

Landing

The "Landing" has been added to the "Permissions" window, which allows you to authorize access for landing for selected groups.

notes.title: Update V0.2.90
notes.notes:
Arrival into the world

Now, each new character will be shown on the world map with a special marker. The marker will be active until the character lands in the docking port of the capital.
Sorharon is an artefact of the Guardians that moves nomads between worlds.
It enables you to use:

Glide - to increase airspeed.
Chain lightning - to damage dragons, enemy ships or strekolets.
Arcane repairs - to restore strength.
Leap - to transfer to a random direction.

During your trip, enjoy the views and get comfortable with the controls and skills.
After landing, the city will provide you with a ship and equipment.

Market

Added the opportunity to trade "Piece of the Inside Out" and "Long leap".

notes.title: Update V0.2.89
notes.notes:
Friends Reunion

The event "Friends Reunion" has ended. During the event, the captains who re-entered the game after a 3-month break received unique medallions. In the future, we will conduct more such events. Stay tuned for updates.

Update history

In the "Information" window, the "Update history" tab has been added. Here you can find all the information about the latest updates.

notes.title: Update V0.2.88
notes.notes:
We are glad to present you the Portrait editor!

Each character you create in the World on the Edge of the Inside Out has a standard portrait of a resident of the Empire or Union.

To go to the editor, click "Open character portrait". Select one of many portraits available in the editor. It will be the basis for the appearance of your character.
Then you can select and change any of the proposed options:

Hair
Eyes
Nose
Lower part of the face
Add scars, tattoo
Glasses
Oxygen mask

A portrait created using the editor can only be applied to a character who has reached level 10.

The first change of the standard portrait to the portrait selected in the editor is free.

For changing the Unique portrait to the portrait selected in the editor, you will have to pay a few gold coins. In this case, the unique portrait will be removed from the game forever.

The number of portraits and proposed options for editor may be increased in future updates.

What is the difference between Unique portraits and portraits created using the Editor?

Unique portraits are painted by our artists in a single copy. These portraits don't exist anywhere else in the world.
The editor enables you to create the appearance of a character from a specific set of portraits and proposed options available to everyone.

Unique portraits

The price of unique portraits is increased.

notes.title: Update V0.2.87
notes.notes:
Added new special levels to the "Engineer", "Mechanic" and "Missile weapons" skills.
 To open access to learning these special levels you need to read the "Turbine Rumble" and "Chopping Strike" books.
 You can find new books (like any other books) in the holds of ships or in a warehouse of a Bastion.
 Special skills enable the production of the TM-2 torpedo engines, MK-2 heavy torpedoes, and 2M torpedoes.
 TM-2 torpedo engines enable the MK-2 and 2M torpedoes to operate at an altitude of up to 7 miles.

notes.title: Update V0.2.86
notes.notes:
Ships

Added new modifications of ship engines of the SM series.
You can find these modifications only in the hold of a ship, wrecked in the Inside Out. Game event "Shipwreck".
Modified engines now have higher power and can operate at heights where standard engines stall.

Enhancers

Installing enhancers has become even easier - just drag an enhancer from a hold/warehouse to an enhancer slot.

notes.title: Update V02.8.5
notes.notes:
Friends Reunion
We are happy to announce that captains who reenter the game after a 3-month break will receive 9 unique medallions:

 Beginner's medallion – 3;
 Medallion of Knowledge – 3;
 Medallion of Wisdom – 3.

Each medallion enables you to learn instantly and for free one of the levels of any skill.
The duration of this event is 1 month.

The maximum number of medallions of each type is limited to 7 per account.

Controls
Now, by pressing “increase/decrease altitude by 100 yards” while holding the "Shift" key down, you can increase/decrease altitude by 500 yards.

notes.title: Update V0.2.84
notes.notes:
Glide

Now you can Right-click on the "Glide" button to decrease the mode's grade

Bug fixes

Fixed a bug leading to an incorrect calculation of the damage done by dragons. Now the amount of damage dealt and the amount of loot depends on the level of a dragon.

Market

A new tip allowing you to see the contents of the hold and the installed enhancers of a ship or a strekolet has been added to the Sale window.

Piece of the Inside Out

We remind that a piece of the Inside Out can be found in the hold of a ship that has been wrecked in the Inside Out.

notes.title: Update V0.2.83
notes.notes:
Magic

In the World on the Edge of the Inside Out, the "Piece of the Inside Out" and “Long leap” have become available.

Property

All tabs of the "Property" window are now minimized by default.

Group of strekolets

Now refueling, reloading of ammunition and installation of enhancers are available for groups of strekolets. Select several strekolets in a hangar. Next, select one of the actions, for example, “Fuel the strekolet”. The command will be applied and the task will be started for each selected strekolet.

notes.title: Update V0.2.82
notes.notes:
Market

Now enhancers, magic items, tools and alchemy are sold only by several cities of the world.
The recovery time of all trading lots produced and sold by cities depends on the number of players in the game.

Repairs

Ships repair time has been reduced.

Ships

Now it is easier to select a ship with a mouse.

New Year event has ended

Snowflakes and Snowmen have melted.

Ammunition

Ammunition damage has been increased by 1.5 times: 10 lb shell (B-10), 37 lb shell (B-37), 1/10 renita charge.

Important!

An inactive settlement will not exist for more than 60 real days. Active actions are: processing, production, repairs, etc.

New Year Event

The New Year event has ended.

On January 22, 2020, all the remaining Snowflakes and Snowmen will melt.

Guild

Now it is possible to filter guild mail by subject.

notes.title: Update V0.2.80

Bastions

Fixed a bug due to which dragons and margudes attacked the floating stones near the Bastions.

Strekolets

Strekolet flight characteristics now depend on the weight of the cargo in the hold, the remaining amount of fuel in the tank, and the installed enhancers.

notes.title: Update V0.2.77
notes.notes:
Guild

The Mail tab has been added to the guild window. This tab contains informational notifications about all important events in the life of the guild. Previously, such information was sent to each member of the guild individually in telegrams.

Bug fixes

Fixed a bug in calculating carrying capacity of ships.

notes.title: Update V0.2.76
notes.notes:
Bug fixes

The cursor movement bug in the chat window was fixed.
The chat error which caused glueing of the text messages from multiple chat tabs while sending a message was fixed.
The visual bug which led to the display of the wrong amount of property thrown from a cargo hold or warehouse of a building was fixed.
The bug due to which the World Map could not be moved within the screen was fixed.

The display of the list of other players in the permissions/access window was corrected.

Market

The opportunity to trade the M-5 engines, Margude energy guns, and renita charges was added to the corresponding tabs of the market.

notes.title: Update V0.2.75
notes.notes:
Weapons

Characteristics of Margudes energy gun and renita charges were changed.

Bug fixes

Several interface bugs were fixed.

notes.title: Update V0.2.74
notes.notes:
Check out the list of improvements and changes introduced in this update.

Game event "Shipwreck"

On a lonely merchant ship, a demon lattice was damaged. As a result, a ship, wrecked by the Inside Out, crashed. The wreckage of a ship is marked on the map with a special marker. The wreckage will be destroyed within 30 minutes from the start of the event.
Watch for the pop-up notifications during the game.
The most efficient captains have a chance to become rich! 

World map was improved

The opportunity to add additional markers to the guild's layers of the map was added. To do this, you must be a member of a guild.
The guild layers correspond to the ranks of a guild. The player cannot see the layers correspond to the positions above his/her rank.
The layer switch can be found on the top right part of the map window.

notes.title: Update V0.2.73
notes.notes:
Check out the list of improvements and changes introduced in this update.
World map

The world map is one of the main tools that help captains navigate the world.

We have collected a large number of wishes and suggestions for improving the World Map interface.

In order to increase the comfort of the gameplay, we add the opportunity to set, edit and remove markers on the World Map.

By default, each marker has a green icon and the opportunity to add a text description: record important information or information about a particular place.

The number of markers is not limited.

Resource deposits or locations of any settlements can be marked with corresponding icons.

notes.title: Update V0.2.72
notes.notes:
Ships

The bug with the movement of ships was fixed.

Interface

The functionality of the "Moving of resources" window was improved. Now, the window remembers the type and amount of property moved.
The opportunity to move any window (Information, Rating, Achievements, Telegraph, etc.) to any part of the screen was added. The next time you open the window, it will be in the place where you moved it.

notes.title: Update V.0.2.71
notes.notes:
Contracts

Cargo delivery contract time limit was changed. It was reduced from 72 to 4 hours.

Ships

"Add to Contacts" button was added.

Settlement

A telegram informing the owner about which of the captains (with access) made the decision to demolish the settlement was added.

notes.title: Update V0.2.70_fix
notes.notes:
Telegraph

A line spacing in telegrams was increased.

Ammunition

The flight path of RSN-missiles was improved.

Ships

A ship control near the surface of the ground was improved.

Players

The spawn point of players from China was fixed.

notes.title: Update V0.2.70
notes.notes:
"Chat" window

The "Guild" tab was added to the chat window. The "Guild" tab stores the last 100 messages of guild members.

"Relations" window

The opportunity to create text notes about every captain was added. Notes will only be visible to you.
The opportunity to create and send telegrams to captains from the "Relations" window was added.
The opportunity to keep track of a captain was added to the "Relations" window. To do this you need to check the Contact box.
The opportunity to search for a captain by name was added. It is at the bottom of the window.

"War" event

Participants of the War event can be attacked by settlements located outside the event zone if the participants inflict damage on settlements or are on the attackers list.

Ammunition

The weight of the R-1, R-1U, RSN-1U missiles was changed.

notes.title: Update V0.2.68_fix
notes.notes:
Aggression mechanics

Now, if the strekolet of captain "A" receive the order to attack a settlement of captain "B", the settlement will add this strekolet to the attackers list. The strekolet from the attackers list will be attacked by anti-aircraft platforms of the settlement as soon as this strekolet pass the 9 miles zone around the settlement.
The 9 miles zone is the maximum detection zone of anti-aircraft platforms of a settlement.
Guild

The bug due to which a captain could not leave a guild (or be excluded from it) was fixed.

notes.title: Update V0.2.68

Window of landing. Use Shift + M (Land), and it will appear.

New Bastion capture mechanics was introduced.

The capture day is Saturday. The capture time is 1 hour from 3 pm to 4 pm UTC (for Bastions, which are under the control of the Guardians).
For the Bastions which are already captured, the time of the next capture is chosen by their owners (Bastion owners are the characters which were the Guild masters at the time of the capture).
The time of capturing the Bastion can be changed by the owner of the Bastion being the Head of the guild or the Advisor during the period from Sunday 0:00 to Monday 11:59 pm (UTC).
The number of the attacking guild should be at least 5 characters at the time of capture.
The Bastion will be captured if the attacking guild gets 4000 points.
The ships of the attacking guild which flew into the capture zone are not attackers to the Bastion owner until they do damage.
The height of the capture zone is 2 miles (from the Bastion), the radius of capture is 4 miles (from the Bastion).
The guild ships must be within 4 miles from a Bastion to capture it.
If the attackers have N ships more than the defenders, they get N points of capture per second. 
If the number of defending ships is equal or bigger than the number of any of the attacking guilds ships, the attackers do not get points of capture. The points of capture are reset if there are no attackers in the zone.
The numbers of attacking ships of different guilds are not summed up.
The ships are counted only if they are under the direct control of the players (the ships under the remote control of the navigator are not counted).
If there are several attacking guilds, the speed of getting the points of capture counts out of the difference in number of the current candidate guild and the next one.
Anti-aircraft guns of bases work as usual during capturing a bastion.
If the Bastion is captured, the master of the guild which captured it becomes its owner. 
After 1 hour time, during which the Bastion is available for capture, skills books appear in the warehouse of the Flight Center no matter whether the owner of the Bastion changed or not.
In the case of capture, all the property stored in the Bastion becomes the property of the master of the guild which seized it.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25334485/a3c18e64746b9acc65398094f366f5de2d150269.png

Changes, additions

Interface

An opportunity to remap control keys was introduced to the game. To remap a key, open "Settings" menu and then "Controls" tab. 
You can see the values of all available «By default» control keys in the appropriate tab of "Information" window.

Goblin

Goblins were added in the in-game world. 
A worker whom you can employ in the Flight Centre of a settlement. 
Goblins like to eat very much. The basis of their diet is a ration pack. Every in-game day one goblin consumes 1 ration pack. The goblin who has started to work will eat 2 ration packs per 1 in-game day. While performing a task, goblins are locked in and cannot run away. If goblins start to starve, they will leave you. One goblin increases the manufacturing productivity of ships, strekolets, weaponry, engines and armour bu 1%. Increases the amount of extracted resources, manufactured materials and ammunition by1%.
You can make a ration pack in the Farm in a settlement or buy it from the market of any capital city.

Wanderer, the ship of Margudes

"Repair discharge" button was added to the control panel of the ship of Margudes. It allows to restore the stock of strength of friendly ships and strekolets without paying a fee. It consumes only the character’s mana. You need "Chain of lightning" skill to use this button.

"War" event

Restoring the strength of the ships of the friends during the event now counts for the reward as the damage done. 
The amount of the damage done to the allies can be compensated by restoring the strength of friendly ship/strekolets.

Market

The number of symbols in "Price" field was increased.

Tools

Two new types of steam automatons with increased amount of charges were added to the market.

Armour

An opportunity to produce "Leather armour plate" was added to the Farm. Leather armour plate is used to produce Leather sheathing. 
"Leather sheathing" is armour which can be installed only in strekolets. Its special feature is that it doesn’t weigh much and gets reduced damage from the lightning. Is produced in the Farm. The installed armour doesn’t affect the speed of a strekolet. 
The old "Armour plate" was renamed to "Armour". 
The way of production of armour was changed. Now it is made of armour plates. Armour plates are produced in the Foundry shop. They don’t need any skill for production. 
An opportunity to repair damaged armour was introduced.

Ships

The speed of take-off/landing of ships depending on the level of the demon was increased. The speed of a ship’s descent is higher than the speed of rising. 
The weight of transported cargo affects the ship’s dynamics.

Correcting errors

The bug of Ox ship getting no damage while landing at the 2nd level Docking port of a multi-purpose settlement was fixed. 
The bug of displaying ships’ location in the character’s property was fixed.

Extraction

The system of extraction by the ship was changed. Lower levels of extraction require less mana, but the resources are depleted faster. 
The cost of extraction of wood in the special settlement Sawmill was reduced.

Queue of tasks

If any task is cancelled, resources spent on setting it will be returned in proportion to the remaining time of performing the task. 
The key combination "Shift+*+key" was replaced by an opportunity to switch tasks in one or several buildings of one settlement.

Strekolets

Strekolets got the "Glide" mode. Be careful as after the activation of the mode air resistance decreases as well as the climbing power. Beware of a crash.

notes.title: Big Update V0.1.63
notes.notes:
Changes in game mechanics, additions.

No more clans. We are introducing the guilds system.
Bastions have appeared in the world – one in each province. Bastions are marked on mini map with a special symbol.
The system of governorship has been changed. From now on, the governors are the players who control bastions. Battle for Bastion time: 0:00 - 23:59 Saturday (UTC).
Non PvP status is active within a 5 mile radius around a Bastion.
No more “non grata” mechanic.
We’ve changed the skill tree. Time for learning skills has been reduced. Some skills’ functions have been changed. That includes Exploration, Extraction, Engineer, Heavy weapons, Rocket weapons.  (read the description to the skills) 
Every skill consists of levels of different stage – beginner, mid and high. Beginner stages of the skills are available from the start. In order to learn mid and high levels, you will need to get the appropriate skill books. The books can be found at crash sites of NPC ships as well as rewards for capturing and holding Bastions. The books are available to buy/sell between players.
Skills responsible for building and piloting ships are different for orcs and humans. If you already learned such a skill, you will have both orc and human skills learned after the new update goes live.
Extraction of resources depends on the skill “Extraction”, which consists of 11 levels. The players, who learned some levels of the old skill “Exploration”, will now have the same number of learned levels for the skill “Extraction”. The skill is responsible for the effectiveness of extraction both from the ship and from the settlement.
Gnomes got a new Blade K 200 ship for sale. 
Time required for building and repairing ships has been reduced.
Louis d’or are no longer required to repair ships. 
Wolf 100 and Boar 100 no longer require any skills to be built and piloted.
You must be in a docking port to install/change weapons, demons, engines and enhancers in your ships. The exception is defense crystals, which you can still install while in the air.
Installed enhancers and weapons influence the ship’s aerodynamic properties, leading to changes in the ship’s max speed.
Some ships’ speed has been increased.
High level demons now affect the ship’s speed as well as its maneuverability.
The faction capitals now only sell low level demons (levels 1 and 4)
Settlements open fire on aggressors regardless of the type of terrain they are built on.
The “attacker” status lasts for 3 hours.
The aggressor’s “attacker” status is only applicable to members of one guild regardless of where their whereabouts. Non-guild members living on the territory controlled by the guild will not be affected. 
A ship can land in a settlement no earlier than in 2 minutes after takeoff. The same applies to when you log in – if your ship is in the air when you log in the game, you will be able to land no earlier than in 2 minutes.
Every city sells sapphires to that city as well as to all other cities within a 100 mile radius around that city.
The prices for some enhancers have been increased. Almost all enhancers sold for gold can be bought in any city.
Resources required to build and upgrade building can be bought on the market. 
"Letter of marque and reprisal", "Lottery ticket", "Grappling hook" items are now sold for silver.
The engines and machine guns production system has been changed.  You don’t need to activate drills, cutters and turbochargers in the buildings anymore. Now they get activated right from the warehouse.  
Some machine guns can no longer be produced. You can produce machine guns of all calibers with the rate of fire of 300, 300(M3) and 1200(M3).
You can now use magic items in strekolets. That includes Chain lightning, Small chain of lightning, Vial of mana.
The buttons “Market” and “Contracts” have been moved in the upper menu and are available at any time.


Thank you, captains!

Few other improvements.

More information about governor’s responsibilities:

If on the lands of a governor a murder took place (player with a negative reputation have destroyed a ship of a player with a positive reputation), this governor will receive a fine of 50 points deduced from the reputation among the race of a victim. 
If on the lands of a governor a murder of a citizen took place (player with a negative reputation have destroyed a ship of player with a positive reputation, which has a settlement on the land of a governor), this governor will receive a fine of 200 points deduced from the reputation among the race of a victim. Wherein the murderer will receive a status “Persona non grata” and will not be able to land in any settlement on the land of this governor, unless the governor decides otherwise and grants him/her a permission. 
A murder that took place above water is not of governor’s concern.
A murder of a positive player conducted by a positive player is not of governor’s concern.
